name: codewriter-typescript-tooling
description: Dependency-resolution home for eslint.config.js and prettier.config.js. ESM bare-specifier imports in a shared config file resolve relative to the config file's own location, not the consuming project's node_modules — so the plugins these configs import must be installed here. Do not add source code here; see ../README.md. eslint is pinned to the 9.x line (not 10.x) because eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5 (latest as of 2026-07) declares peer support only up to eslint ^9.7 and crashes at runtime under eslint 10 (`contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function`) — bump once a react-plugin release adds eslint 10 support.
